name: Eadán

attributes.attribute: an Irish hero who came with the Milesians
killed the goddess Fódla at the battle of Tailtiu
one of the three primary goddesses of the land

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Eadán is an Irish hero. He sailed to Ireland with the Milesians, the final wave of invaders. They won the battle of Tailtiu over the Tuatha Dé Danann, who follow the goddess Danu. Within that group they faced Fódla, a primary goddess of the land, one of three. The others were Banba and Ériu. Eadán killed Fódla in battle. Not all her people died. Many moved to an Otherworld and kept shaping the land they had quit.

okr.objective: Describe Eadán, a Milesian hero who killed the goddess Fódla at Tailtiu.
key_results: Eadán came to Ireland with the Milesians, the last wave of invaders.
